# David Rupert Duca

> David Rupert Duca is a Filipino Applications Architect, Web Developer and AI Specialist, and Co-founder of SeedLynx. He holds TESDA Computer Systems Servicing NC II and Cisco Networking Academy certifications, is a BS Information Systems student at Carlos Hilado Memorial State University, and is open to freelance work, collaborations and internships.
